name: queue_rows
description:
Deterministic slice of queues/<queue>.tsv, id-lines only (id<TAB>STATE<TAB>col2): view=counts|open|head|tail|row|has.
    counts: rows and per-state counts; open: rows not closed/claimed/deployed; head/tail: first/last n rows; row: every row whose
    id == row_id (all fields, each capped 240 chars); has: row_id across ALL queues (queue left empty). queue= file stem,
    e.g. P3-LENS-QUEUE; state= keeps only rows in that state word (see counts); match= keeps rows containing that text (case-insensitive); open = OPEN|RELEASED|ROW|-|WAIT. Fails open: 'COULD NOT LOOK' -> read the .tsv as before.
